messages:
Nina Sales: Heads-up - FinCorp wants a BYOK POC: CMK in their CloudHSM, attestation proof, and show a 30-day rotation. Can Redwood prove key material never leaves their HSM? @Omar Sec?
Omar Sec: We can state we never export customer CMKs from a supported HSM. Need to be precise: 'never leaves HSM' vs 'Redwood never has plaintext key'. Ask legal for NDA addendum.
Priya Eng: For POC propose flow: Redwood references customer KMS (KMIP/CloudHSM) and performs crypto ops via API. No key storage on our side. Simpler than upload/unwrap flow.
Ben SRE: Note latency: each HSM call adds network RTT (10-30ms typical). Recommend caching ephemeral envelope keys for high QPS. We'll run latency tests in staging.
Clara Solutions: Draft POC scope: 1) ingest attestation doc, 2) configure staging to point to customer HSM, 3) run scripted rotation initiated by customer, 4) collect latency/errors. ETA 10 business days.
Nina Sales: Procurement asks: who pays HSM hours and any per-KMS fees?
Omar Sec: Customer owns HSM billing. We don't add per-KMS fees for Dedicated. If we store wrapped keys or perform admin rotations for them we'll add SOW line item.
Priya Eng: I'll prepare a demo script and a minimal diagram. Example rotation call: curl -X POST https://pi.redwood.ai/v1/admin/rotate-key -d '{"key_id":"cmk-ff","rotation_source":"customer-hsm"}'
Ben SRE: Add failure test: HSM unreachable should fall back to cached read-only key for 5s then error. Need sign-off on fallback window.
Nina Sales: Action items: Clara draft FAQ + SOW, Priya demo + diagram, Omar security wording + NDA note. I'll book kickoff with their infra lead tomorrow.
DeployBot: [deploy] Created staging cluster 'fincorp-byok-poc' (id: stg-6721)
